sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Sin and want we come confessing;
Thou canst save, and Thou canst heal.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Though the night be dark and dreary,
Thou art He who, never weary,

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: Though the arrow past us fly,
Angel guards from Thee Surround us,
We are safe if Thou art nigh.

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: Should swift death this night o're-take us,
And our couch become our tomb,
May the morn of glory wake us,
Clad in light and deathless bloom.
